description: Counterfactual: Minimal perturbation to flip SVM decision while keeping AlexNet invariant
methodology: Representer Theorem inverse - compute gradient w.r.t. input to flip decision

counterfactual_logic.principle: Find minimal ||δ|| such that sign(f(x + δ)) ≠ sign(f(x))
counterfactual_logic.formulation: δ* = argmin ||δ||² subject to y·f(x + δ) ≤ 0

example_computation.interpretation: Move away from support vectors with positive contribution

alexnet_invariance.constraint: Perturbation must not affect max-pooling mask in Conv5→FC6 pathway
alexnet_invariance.spatial_requirement: δ must be within receptive field that doesn't change pool indices
alexnet_invariance.mathematical_form: max_pool(x + δ) = max_pool(x) for affected pooling regions

delivery.format: JSON with perturbation vector and validation
delivery.verification: Show decision flip while preserving spatial features
